links.comparator_used: Same correct diagnostic advice shown without a visual annotation on the X-ray
links.outcome: Physician diagnostic accuracy (also advice quality ratings and confidence)
links.effect: Annotated advice from an AI gave the highest diagnostic accuracy. Non-task experts benefited considerably from correct explainable AI advice. No strong effect of the manipulations on confidence. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Overall, receiving annotated advice from an AI resulted in the highest diagnostic accuracy.

links.comparator_used: The same correct diagnostic advice labeled as coming from a human radiologist
links.effect: Physicians rated AI-labeled advice higher than human-labeled advice; no numeric effect size reported in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: No strong effect on participants' confidence was found.
links.quote: Physicians rated the quality of AI advice higher than human advice.

design_hint: visual annotation (explainability) and AI source labeling of diagnostic advice
